svg.title: Ring, back: SF 68.463
svg.desc: Ring, back. 30 N on the outer rear of the ring, pushing +x. SF 68.463, required 2.
svg.text: 30 N on the outer rear of the ring, pushing +x
Reproduces the record's SF bit for bit (Tier 2 at h 0.2, same platform).
Grey: not read (within 3 mm of the seat). The capacity is the as-built wall allowable over the peak per newton.
T6 ring and neck membrane, 8241 elements · seat x 40-46 mm clamped · deformation ×500 · line: undeformed
